officialHistoricalObservation.pageDefinition: Betfair states that the table reports average prize payout as a percentage of total collected, calculated for the previous month in Betfair.es Casino.

scientificInterpretation.reason: The 94.74% figure is an aggregate historical realized payout over an unknown finite sample size and unknown player/mode mix. Sampling variance and mode mixing prevent inference of the exact served theoretical RTP or jackpot trigger function. Its numerical proximity to any published RTP sub-range is not evidence that Betfair served that configuration.
scientificInterpretation.allowedUse: Operator-specific historical sanity check only. It can falsify claims that depend on an impossible historical payout range only with additional denominator/sample information; absent that information it is not an execution input.
